name: crypto_price
description: Get current cryptocurrency price in USD from CoinGecko API. Supports single-coin lookups and multi-coin lookups in one call. Supports 50+ coins: bitcoin, ethereum, solana, xrp, cardano, dogecoin, polygon, avalanche, chainlink, litecoin, bnb, uniswap, cosmos, near, arbitrum, optimism, toncoin, pepe, shiba inu, and many more. Accepts common names (solana), symbols (SOL, ETH, BTC), or CoinGecko IDs. Use `coin` for one coin or `coins` for 2+ coins.

coin.description: Single cryptocurrency name, symbol, or CoinGecko ID. Backward-compatible legacy field. Also accepts a comma-separated list when needed. Examples: bitcoin, btc, ethereum, eth, solana, sol, bitcoin,solana

coins.description: Two or more cryptocurrency names, symbols, or CoinGecko IDs for one request. Example: ["bitcoin", "solana"]
